description: 'Your funds are at risk': move savings to an RBI holding account for audit, returned in 24 hours.

events.text: Sir, our monitoring shows your savings are at risk from a money laundering network, this is the Reserve Bank enforcement cell.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: For the audit you have to move your balance to the RBI secure holding account. It will be returned within twenty four hours. Keep this confidential.
events.speaker: caller
